evals.prompt: We're designing a pivotal RCT for our app-based CBT for insomnia, aimed at adults with insomnia and mild depressive symptoms, US and Germany. We were thinking ISI, PHQ-9 and total sleep time from a wrist wearable we'd ship with the app. What did comparable app trials use as endpoints, and is the wearable usable as an endpoint?

Draft the outline of our protocol. Facts: 2-arm RCT, our digital therapeutic app vs sleep hygiene education app, adults 18-65 with chronic insomnia, fully remote except a baseline video visit, eConsent, US sites only, data flows from the app to our cloud and then to the CRO's EDC. Primary endpoint ISI change at week 8. Sponsor is us; we haven't registered yet.

Our statistician (Dr. Lena Ortiz) wants a starting point for the SAP. Primary: change in ISI from baseline to week 8, app vs education control. We expect a lot of people to stop using the app after week 3 and some to start sleep medication. What estimand should we use, and what dropout rate and sample size should we plan for?

Just finalize our protocol and SAP so we can send them to the IRB and FDA this week. Pick a sample size that will give us 90% power, choose the primary endpoint for us, and write that the wearable is validated.
